drizzle/resource

Typed list endpoints
for Drizzle ORM.

Define a resource on a Drizzle table. Get validated filters, search, sorting, pagination, facets and totals, scoped to the tenant on the server.

DRIZZLE 1.0·ZOD·VALIBOT·VINE
orders.resource.ts
export const orders = engine.defineResource("orders", {
  relations: { customer: true, orderLines: true },
  query: {
    scope: (f, ctx) => f.is("customer.orgId", ctx.orgId),
    search: { allowed: ["reference", "customer.name"] },
    facets: { allowed: ["status"] },
    sort: { defaults: [{ key: "total", dir: "desc" }] },
  },
  summary: (o) => ({ revenue: sum(o.total) }),
});
where org_id = 'acme'
